guide.title: Exercise Guide
guide.subtitle: Choose an exercise to review correct form and camera positioning.
guide.push_start:
• Place the camera side-on to your body.
• Put your wrists below your shoulders.
• Brace your core and form a straight line from head to heels.
guide.push_end:
• Lower your chest under control until elbows reach about 70–90°.
• Press back to full elbow extension while keeping your body aligned.
guide.push_mistakes:
• Hips sagging or raised.
• Partial elbow range.
• Elbows flaring too far.
• Wrists or elbows leaving the frame.
guide.push_tips: Breathe in while lowering and out while pressing. Move the camera farther away and improve lighting if tracking is lost.
guide.crunch_posture:
• Lie side-on with knees bent and feet planted.
• Keep your lower back stable and your hands light beside your head.
• Keep your neck neutral.
guide.crunch_range:
• Curl your shoulders toward your knees using your core.
• Lower until your upper back returns to the floor.
• Keep every repetition slow and controlled.
guide.crunch_mistakes:
• Pulling the neck.
• Sitting all the way up.
• Using momentum.
• Moving out of the camera frame.
guide.crunch_tips: Exhale while curling upward. Keep your nose, shoulder, hip, and knee visible throughout the movement.
